verdict.rationale: Intuit's official QuickBooks Online MCP server lists Balance Sheet, P&L, and Cash Flow among its 11 financial reports, so QBO itself produces all three statements. Intuit Intelligence also claims to generate reports on request. However, the evidence never documents choosing an arbitrary period, how the core in-app reports work, or their accuracy. missing for 10: first-party docs on in-app P&L/balance sheet/cash-flow reports, custom/any-period date selection, evidence of accuracy, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can generate an accurate P&L, balance sheet, and cash-flow statement for any period on demand

citations.quote: 11 Financial Reports - Balance Sheet, P&L, Cash Flow, and more
